event_name: the entity kind, one of contest, task, team, user, submission, subchange
data: the operation and the key, joined by a space: '<create|update|delete> <key>'
id: hexadecimal microseconds since the epoch, assigned at publish time (Publisher.put)
warmup: a subscriber that supplies last_event_id which the cache cannot cover receives 'event:reinit' first
keepalive: a bare comment line immediately on connect, then a comment ping whenever the stream is idle; no retry line is sent (the retry hint is commented out in the source)
registration: DataWatcher registers create, update and delete callbacks for every store, so the six kinds times three operations is the complete event vocabulary
derived_not_captured: the ping interval and the retry value as they appear on the wire
the exact id of the first event after connect
